title: CrowdStrike Falcon or Microsoft Sentinel: EDR Platform vs Cloud SIEM
excerpt: These products are often compared but do different jobs. Falcon protects endpoints; Sentinel is a cloud SIEM that collects and correlates data from across your environment. Many organisations use both.
verdict: Choose CrowdStrike when endpoint protection is the priority and you want a focused, quick-to-deploy platform. Choose Sentinel when you need security monitoring across cloud, network and applications in one place, especially in a Microsoft-centric estate. The two can be integrated so endpoint alerts feed the SIEM.
